scope: RC1 native package consistency and root discovery; no publisher authentication or complete RC1 acceptance

ami-rust-package-inputs-v2.launcher_binding: Both rows have identical nonzero byte lengths/digests; core_sha256 equals that digest because both frontends contain the same statically linked core
ami-rust-package-inputs-v2.assets: Exactly SHA256SUMS and the versioned release archive, archive Sigstore bundle, archive SPDX, transport and transport Sigstore bundle
ami-rust-package-inputs-v2.publisher_proofs: Exactly the checksum, archive, SPDX and transport subject names; each has 1 to 64 exact bytes/sha256 rows
ami-rust-package-inputs-v2.workflow_counters: Exact positive decimal integers, no leading zero, through 4300 digits
ami-rust-package-inputs-v2.host: Selected package host; producer host in authenticated provenance remains separate

ami-rust-package-inventory-v2.binding: Version/host fields match pins; exact owned regular-file set, modes, sizes and digests; self inventory bytes are retained and checked separately

ami-rust-package-proofs-v2.binding: Exactly the four pinned subjects; each identity set matches publisher_proofs; a shared proof path has one identity and case aliases refuse

payload.additional_files: Only the pinned assets/, indexed proofs/, optional README.md, and nonempty portable licenses/ data files
payload.links: No link inside the owned inventory root. Public package-manager/retained entrypoint links may resolve to an owned binary outside that root.
payload.directories: Empty extra real directories preserve historical acceptance, within the host tree-work bound

profiles.meaning: Host package-container and traversal profiles; not AROS application quotas. The measured packaging.2 assets are about 27 MiB; the native total profile leaves room for both frontends, notices and future artifact growth. Large prerequisite trees are acquired into private state, not bundled here.

root_discovery.source: Actual executable path supplied by the operating system, separately from argv[0] used for Cargo dispatch
root_discovery.identity: Canonical existing payload path without linked components; executable bytes, package host and compiled CLI version match pins and inventory
root_discovery.relocation: All inventory/pin paths are relative; no activation path is serialized into these portable records

compatibility.v1_packages: Read-only historical evidence/migration inputs; never native package authorization or an executable Python fallback
compatibility.bare_development_binary: Existing help/version remain development-only. Package discovery does not silently fall back to an ambient installation or an unverified metadata root.
compatibility.public_activation: Remain disabled until integrated supported-host, no-Python and complete consumer-path checks pass. No new distribution or SDK publication is authorized by a parser result.
